sections.A: AC joint hansli ke bahar wale siray ko shoulder blade ke upar wale hisse (acromion) se jorta hai. Kandhe par girne se yeh jor zakhmi hota hai.
sections.B: Kandhe ke upar AC joint par dard, girne ya chot ke baad. Bare grade mein wahan ubhar ya step nazar aata hai.
sections.C: Kaise chot lagi, aur kya patient ek ungli se dard ki jagah bata sakta hai.
sections.D: Kharabi, jild ka khinchna, sujan dekhein, aur AC joint aur poori hansli ko dabayein.
sections.E: AC joint par dabana, cross-body adduction aur O'Brien test. Har test ki hadd yaad rakhein.
sections.F: Hansli ka fracture, sternoclavicular joint ki chot aur kandhe ka utarna isi jaise lag sakte hain.
sections.G: Jild ka khinchna, hansli ki kharabi aur baazu na uthna, ya haath mein sunn-pan: foran refer.
sections.H: Red flags na hon, AC par local dard, kandhe par girna aur cross-body test dard wala ho to AC joint injury.
sections.I: Kandhe ke gird soft tissue aur thoracic mobilisation. AC joint par seedha zor nahi.
sections.J: Pehle hifazat (pendulum, kohni aur haath ki movement), phir range, phir taaqat aur kaam ya khel par wapsi.
sections.K: Pehle dinon mein barf optional; TENS aur taping optional.
sections.L: Screen karein, zaroorat ho to imaging, phir thori der sling, jaldi movement aur dheere dheere taaqat.
sections.M: Dard, AC par dard, cross-body dard, range, taaqat aur QuickDASH dobara dekhein.
sections.N: 28 saal ka cyclist kandhe ke siray par gira aur AC par chhota ubhar hai. Khud socho, phir jawab dekho.
sections.chapter-summary-treatment-decision: Mukhtasar: hifazat, dard control aur jaldi dheere dheere movement.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
